components.title: Emby cast service
components.description: For the app Emby: the head unit as a cast target in the Emby phone app (Emby's remote control, as Kodi's Emby add-on), and the film's player: the server sends H.264 up to 1080p with AAC or AC-3, decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it while parked) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); keeps only the access token. Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13101 only; the player runs as nobody (as AirPlay Test's receiver).
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Media Probe service
components.description: For the app Media Probe: what the car offers a music player (the first step of a Music Assistant client). Watches the steering wheel's buttons, the source the HMI takes as playing, CarLife's bridge to BMW's media and the BMW MediaPlayer, and runs tests the app starts: source 287 with a tone, CarLife's metadata written, button forwarding, source 1046 with MP3 / M4A / AAC files, a growing file, a pipe and http:// streams on 127.0.0.1. Everything a test changes is undone when it ends. No internet. Logs to /var/opt/aurelm-mediaprobe/state/probe.log; Report copies it to a USB stick.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Music Assistant service
components.description: For the app Music Assistant: the car as a Music Assistant player. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code) and keeps only a long-lived token. Browses the library and the recommendations over the server's API, and receives the music over Sendspin (Music Assistant's own protocol, through its authenticated /sendspin): Opus decoded by ma-player (libopus) into SmartXbar's CarLife input. 30 s of music are buffered (a gap in the mobile network goes unheard). Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13106 only; the player runs as nobody.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: myAirPlay service
components.description: For the app myAirPlay: the AirPlay receiver "BMW iDrive" (UxPlay's protocol on the head unit). The iPhone's screen mirroring decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file and its sound into SmartXbar's CarLife input; a video sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by its own player from the internet (mgu-uplink, through a proxy running as uid 13102). Opens the firewall for its ports only while the receiver runs.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: TVH Player service
components.description: For the app TVH Player: Tvheadend's channels on the head unit. The channel comes with one of the server's transcoding profiles (mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced by the server, AAC, MPEG-TS), is decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it while parked) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); keeps the server, the user and the password (root's, 0600). Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13103 only; the player runs as nobody.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: Apex Chase
components.description: A maze chase in a city at night, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: the M car collects the fuel drops while four electric cars hunt it; a NITRO can drains their batteries. iDrive controller or swipes. Parked only.

components.title: Blackjack
components.description: Casino blackjack for play credits, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: a felt table with a leather rail, cards dealt from the shoe, chips, six decks, 3 to 2, double, split, insurance, a strategy hint, statistics. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.

components.title: Emby
components.description: The head unit as a cast target for the Emby phone app: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then choose "BMW iDrive" in Emby's cast menu. The film plays on the centre screen while parked, its sound on the car's speakers; pause, seek and stop from the phone. Needs the Emby cast service.

components.title: Engine Care
components.description: PHEV B48 operating hours, EV vs ICE split, cold hard starts, engine runs that never warm the oil, battery charge at engine starts and true oil degradation next to BMW CBS

components.title: Hybrid Cost
components.description: PHEV running cost calculator: live electric vs petrol cost per 100 km in 11 currencies, dynamic torque split, trip savings and a price editor for fuel and electricity

components.title: Lap Record
components.description: Time trial on a circuit seen from above, the camera on the car: the knob is the steering wheel, lap after lap against your best and its ghost, the gap live, sectors in purple, green and yellow. Two circuits, kerbs, gravel, tyre walls, grandstands, tyre smoke and marks. GPU renderer. Parked only.

components.title: Lucky Sevens
components.description: A five reel slot machine for play credits, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: glossy symbols, reels that bounce to a stop, ten paylines, WILD, free spins, a progressive jackpot, statistics. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.

components.title: Media Probe
components.description: What the car offers a music player (the first step of a Music Assistant client): the steering wheel's buttons, the source the HMI takes as playing, CarLife's bridge to BMW's media, button forwarding, and the BMW MediaPlayer's source for apps with files, a growing file, a pipe and http:// streams. Each test shows what the car answered; Report copies the log to a USB stick. Needs the Media Probe service.

components.title: Music Assistant
components.description: Your Music Assistant server in the car: the home page's recommendations with their covers, the library (playlists, albums, artists, radio, tracks), search, and what plays with its cover, its progress and what comes next. The music comes over Sendspin and plays on the car's speakers; skip on the steering wheel goes to the next or the previous track; the track shows on the instrument cluster. Sign in once from the phone (QR code). Needs the Music Assistant service.

components.title: myAirPlay
components.description: The head unit as an AirPlay receiver for an iPhone: screen mirroring on the centre screen with the sound on the car's speakers (also with wireless CarPlay connected), and videos sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by the head unit itself, with their controls on the iDrive. The picture shows while parked. Needs the myAirPlay service.

components.title: M Pinball
components.description: A pinball table on the circuit: wheels for bumpers, the CHICANE ramp, the PIT LANE, the M-POWER targets and SAFETY CAR MULTIBALL, seen in perspective with real ball physics; drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps. Flippers on the controller or a finger on each half of the table. Parked only.

components.title: Pit Wall
components.description: Break the advertising panels off the pit wall: a night race scene drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps, the ball on an M front wing, start lights, combos and power-ups. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.

components.title: Ridge Duel
components.description: Two armed cars on hills at dusk, a turn each: aim with the knob, hold for power, fire. Ground that shells bite into, wind, four kinds of shell, a rival aimed by the game. Your car: a sport sedan (agile) or a performance SUV (armoured), in your colour. GPU renderer. Parked only.

components.title: Snake
components.description: Snake on the central display, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: steer with the iDrive controller (push or turn) or swipe on the screen. Parked only.

components.title: Solitaire
components.description: Klondike solitaire drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: a felt card table, cards that fly, flip and bounce home. Tap or press for the best move, drag cards, draw one or three, undo, hint, auto finish, statistics. Parked only.

components.title: Street Siege
components.description: Defend the M garage: cars storm the town by night and the M car stops them with its roof cannon. Five districts in turn (the yard, the docks, the warehouses, the parking, the scrapyard) laid out as mazes with wide streets: tyres, containers, warehouses, fences, pallets, wrecks, water, oil; power-ups; drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps. Parked only.

components.title: Track Defender
components.description: Arcade shooter on the central display, drawn by the GPU renderer at 60 fps: drones attack the track in waves, the M car shoots them down. iDrive controller or touch. Parked only.

components.title: TVH Player
components.description: Tvheadend's TV channels on the centre screen: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then Watch, Channel + / -, or the channel list over the picture. Skip < > on the steering wheel changes the channel. The picture shows while parked, the sound plays on the car's speakers. The server transcodes (profiles mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced, AAC) and the profile goes down by itself when the internet is slow. Needs the TVH Player service.

components.title: CarPlay cluster map (stream 111)
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Preloads a hook into carplay 20.40.2 that adds CarPlay's second screen (stream 111, the phone's cluster map) and hands it out as H.264 on 127.0.0.1:6111, for Cast to cluster. Installs in mode off (answers as stock); hook111-arm.sh mode alt turns the second screen on. Armed per start; carplay starts stock after two failed starts. Streamed on one car by hand (0.0.6); this install from the Store is new.

Drive modes: a color for each drive mode (Sport, Comfort, Eco Pro, their Plus and Individual, Adaptive) that the light switches to with the mode, on or off. Works while the car's own ambient light is on. Needs the Comfort tool from the same source. Works with the touchscreen or the iDrive controller. iDrive 7 and

components.title: RideTube service
components.description: The car side of RideTube, an unofficial client for YouTube: yt-dlp (from its official release, run in mgu-python) fetches as the daemon's own internet uid; search, feeds and thumbnails on the car (jap-node22); audio through the BMW MediaPlayer, video decoded by ytdec into the mgu-render video layer; TV device sign-in; controlled by the RideTube app over /run/jap-ridetube-d/ctl.sock

components.title: RideWatch service
components.description: The RideWatch app's background service: the stream and the events from your RideWatch server through a local SOCKS5 proxy, the H.264 decoder (Intel MSDK) into mgu-render
components.author: JustAnotherPU

components.title: wireproxy
components.description: A client for the WireGuard® protocol to your own server (no account, no relay), with a SOCKS5 server on 127.0.0.1; picks the endpoint, MTU and TCP send buffer for home Wi-Fi or 5G; does nothing until you write its configuration (README)
components.author: JustAnotherPU

components.title: Moonride
components.description: Moonlight game streaming from your PC (Sunshine / Apollo / Vibepollo) on the iDrive 7 screen, parked only by default. Needs a USB gamepad (XInput) or the touchscreen.
components.author: JustAnotherPU

components.title: RideTube
components.description: Video in the car: an unofficial client for YouTube. Your Home, Subscriptions, Watch later, History and playlists (signed in on the car), search, channels and chapters; the sound through the car's media player, the picture only while parked (a podcast view while driving). Needs the jap-ridetube-d tool.

components.title: RideWatch
components.description: Your UniFi Protect cameras on the iDrive 7 screen, parked only by default: the camera that matters big, the others beside it, a timeline of detections with their clips. Needs your own RideWatch server (Linux, ffmpeg) and a tunnel to it.
components.author: JustAnotherPU

components.title: Doodle Jump
components.description: Doodle Jump for MGU7
components.author: kxrxh

components.title: X3 Home bridge
components.description: Локальный bridge с pairing и запретом произвольных команд Home Assistant

components.title: Только важное
components.description: Слой отклонений 12 В, шин и CBS на приборной панели/HUD с живым превью

components.title: Bimmer Code
components.description: Каталог 10 функций G01 и чтение доступных блоков; запись кодировок отключена

components.title: Здоровье X3
components.description: Read-only приборная панель CBS, 12 В и блоков ECU: приборы, история снимков, отчёт

components.title: X3 ↔ Дом
components.description: Разрешённые сцены Home Assistant кнопками на экране и ручная телеметрия через локальный bridge

components.title: Поездки и расходы
components.description: Локальные поездки, категории, топливо, итоги за период и CSV без геолокации

components.title: Тёплый старт
components.description: Приборы прогрева масла/ОЖ, кольцо готовности и рекомендация климата без записи в блоки

components.title: Android Auto log (for CarLink)
components.description: Experimental. Copies the car's Android Auto daemon's log (journalctl -u aapd, the last 2000 lines) and a snapshot of its state (systemctl status, waze-on-cluster's aapd patch, /etc/aapd.conf against its backup, and the network: addresses, routes and the firewall rules) to /run/mdq-aapd-log, where CarLink shows it on the phone (Car log, Debug on). Runs as root but only reads; writes only that folder, which goes when it stops. Starts at the next head-unit start after its install.
components.author: 7amoody1985

components.title: RideTube service (fork by 7amoody1985)
components.description: The car side of the RideTube fork (JustAnotherPU's RideTube, modified, with its own ids): yt-dlp fetches on the car, the sound through the BMW MediaPlayer, the picture decoded by ytdec. The playing video streams in RAM (a 256 MB tmpfs) instead of being written whole to the head unit's flash; a debug report in /run/mdq-ridetube-d/status.json and log/sessions.jsonl. Needs Node.js 22 from the JustAnotherPU/mgu-apps source. Source: github.com/7amoody1985/ridetube
components.author: JustAnotherPU, modified by 7amoody1985

components.title: CarLink (experimental)
components.description: Experimental. The next turn from HudHud or Google Maps on your phone, in the middle of the instrument cluster and as a home-screen widget, sent by the CarLink phone app. With the car on the phone's hotspot (the Store's Wi-Fi uplink), the car calls the phone; on the car's Wi-Fi or USB tethering, the phone calls the car. Demo shows it without the phone. Needs cluster-render from the robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps source.
components.author: 7amoody1985

components.title: RideTube (fork by 7amoody1985)
components.description: A modified build of JustAnotherPU's RideTube (github.com/JustAnotherPU/ridetube), not endorsed by its developer, with its own ids: it installs beside the original and never over it (only one of them plays at a time). Fixes the Search menu (and the settings in it) closing right after it opens; its service streams the video in RAM instead of writing it to the head unit's flash. Source: github.com/7amoody1985/ridetube
components.author: JustAnotherPU, modified by 7amoody1985

components.title: Cast to cluster
components.description: Plays a stream URL from your phone on the instrument cluster, the HUD or the media console, with its sound through the speakers: scan the QR code, paste a URL, pick where it goes. With hook111 armed, also CarPlay's own second screen (its cluster map) on the cluster or the HUD. Controlled by touch on the central screen too, parked or driving, where mgu-render is installed

components.title: Browser
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. A web browser (Chromium 156) running on the car, with WebGL 2, WebGPU (on the CPU; WebGL on the car's own GPU driver in an experimental GPU mode) and WebAssembly JSPI, shown on the central screen while parked and driven by touch, with its controls on a touch screen, parked or driving (Show on the screen, Back, Reload, Home, the resolution, GPU and game mode). Type addresses on the phone page: scan the QR code on the Browser app's touch screen or iDrive page. About 181 MB to download, 420 MB on the unit.

components.title: Cast

components.title: Browser

components.title: Steam
